name_reason: Trailing _50004 equals the symbol's own address 0x00050004 -- a Ghidra address residue, not a domain ID (not chapter/item/spell/job/portrait range, dimension, or multiplier), so it must be dropped per naming rules. The descriptor 'oom_msg_load_pbuf' already uniquely disambiguates this copy from the sibling OOM literals (oom_msg_tile_event @ 0x50023, oom_msg_runtime_char @ 0x50037), so the address suffix is redundant. Stripped name has no collision. Rest of the name is compliant: data_fd2_ prefix, save_load domain (lives in fd2_load_save_and_init_engine), 'string'/'msg' reflect the char[] string data type. Rename to be applied in Stage 2 (touches globals.h declaration + the single reader fd2_load_save_and_init_engine).
purpose: Read-only ASCII C string " Out of Memory !!!\n" (printf format) emitted on the save-buffer malloc(0x59CB) OOM abort path of fd2_load_save_and_init_engine.
logic_summary: Static const char[20] = " Out of Memory !!!\n" + NUL. In fd2_load_save_and_init_engine @ 0x10051, when malloc(0x59CB) for the save buffer returns NULL, the OOM block sets the printf argument to this string, resets the video mode via int386(0x10,...), printf()s the message, and calls exit(). Watcom emitted 3 identical literals for the 3 OOM basic blocks of that function; only this first copy was given a named symbol/xref. Sibling copies at 0x50023 (malloc 0x8A3 tile_event path) and 0x50037 (malloc 0x1E00 runtime_char path) are referenced via inline string literals in the same function.
datatype: const char[20] (NUL-terminated ASCII C string, 19 chars + NUL)
element_semantics: Each byte is one ASCII character of the message " Out of Memory !!!\n"; final byte 0x00 is the C string NUL terminator. Consumed as a char* by printf.
comment_original_issue: Original src comment was accurate but did not state which of the function's three malloc failures this copy serves, unlike the sibling entries (0x50023/0x50037/0x50064) which each name their specific malloc path; lacked the cross-reference to the duplicate literals.
notes: Single xref to 0x50004 is a DATA read from 0x10051 inside fd2_load_save_and_init_engine; no writers -> confirms const/read-only. Ghidra datatype 'string' length 20, value " Out of Memory !!!\n". Ghidra plate was empty (doc had been mis-placed in PRE_COMMENT); created proper PLATE_COMMENT via run_script_inline (data plate mechanism) and cleared the stale PRE_COMMENT. src comment refined via Edit (comment block above the symbol only). No logic/type/declaration changed; rename only recorded for Stage 2.
